title: You Are 10,000 Meters Under the Ocean

end_card.title: THE DEEPEST PART OF OUR PLANET.

music.mood: dark ambient, deep-sea tension, slow pulse

research.summary: Full-ocean-depth crewed submersibles such as DSV Limiting Factor protect their occupants inside a titanium pressure sphere (Ti-6Al-4V, about 1.5 m inside diameter, 90 mm wall), rated by DNV to 11,000 m (design pressure about 1,127 bar). Pressure grows about 1 atmosphere every 10 m of seawater, so at 10,000 m it is roughly 1,000 times surface pressure. Viewports are thick conical acrylic windows. Sunlight fades out by about 1,000 m (start of the aphotic zone); below that the only light is from bioluminescent animals and the vehicle's own lamps. The deepest known point, Challenger Deep, is about 10,935 m deep.
facts_checked: Pressure sphere: titanium, ~1.5 m inside diameter, 90 mm wall (Limiting Factor).
Rated to 11,000 m; design pressure 1,127 bar (DNV).
~1 atm per 10 m of seawater -> ~1,000x surface pressure at 10 km.
Viewports are acrylic, the hull itself is titanium.
Aphotic zone: essentially no sunlight below ~1,000 m; bioluminescence is the main light source.

cast: otto (submersible pilot, seen in the cutaway; first-person 'you')

scenes.narration: You're now ten thousand meters beneath the ocean. You're sitting inside a tiny submersible.
scenes.storyboard: HOOK. First-person inside the sphere: hands at the glowing control panel, depth readout ticking to 10,000 m, circular front window, the water outside darkening, marine snow rising past.
scenes.camera: first-person, slow forward drift, subtle vibration

scenes.narration: Outside your window, there's complete darkness.
scenes.storyboard: Close to the thick conical acrylic window: endless black water, tiny bioluminescent specks blinking, warm cabin lights reflected on the glass.
scenes.camera: approach the window, look slightly left and right

scenes.narration: The pressure surrounding you is over a thousand times greater than at the surface. A single structural failure could be catastrophic.
scenes.storyboard: Exterior: the small submersible inside an enormous dark water column. Pressure arrows squeeze it from every side; a depth gauge rises to the far-away surface: 0 m, sunlight ends ~1,000 m, you at 10,000 m.
scenes.camera: slow orbit, pull back and tilt up the column

scenes.narration: But somehow, you're still alive. Your submarine is protected by a specially engineered pressure-resistant hull. Its thick walls keep the crushing ocean pressure outside.
scenes.storyboard: Exterior into a cutaway: the foam body and the titanium sphere are sectioned to show the 9 cm wall and the pilot inside with cabin lights; pressure arrows stop at the hull.
scenes.camera: exterior, cutaway, then slow rotation around the hull

scenes.narration: And as you look into the darkness… You realize something terrifying.
scenes.storyboard: First-person: a translucent glowing jellyfish drifts past the window; far away, a mysterious lure-light of a deep-sea fish bobs in the dark.

scenes.narration: You're exploring a world where sunlight has never reached.
scenes.storyboard: The tiny submersible's lamps light a small patch of the trench floor; the camera pulls back until it is a speck of light in endless darkness; title; fade to black.
